resources.string: Your desktop and network over USB
The web page turns this on for you when you click Launch. You can also turn it on here.
Your network keeps working as normal until the web page connects.
Turn on USB debugging in Developer options, and plug this phone into a computer.
On the computer, open %1$s in Chrome or Edge.
Pick a Wisp server and click Launch. Your desktop opens in the browser, and this phone gets online through it.
Android needs your OK before Asahi can act as a VPN.
Asahi was turned off because another VPN took over, or it was turned off in Settings.
Another VPN has taken over. Click Launch on the web page again, or turn Asahi on here.
Another app is using Asahi\'s connection name. Restart the phone and try again.
